name: Ms. Igwe Mary
title: Founder of Mary Gold
bio:
Ms. Igwe Mary is the Founder of Mary Gold, an organization registered with the Corporate Affairs Commission of Nigeria. She is passionate about youth development and empowerment, with a vision of helping young people become capable, confident, responsible, and purpose-driven individuals.

Through Mary Gold, Ms. Igwe Mary is committed to promoting opportunities that encourage young people to discover their potential, develop their abilities, and contribute positively to their communities. Her leadership is guided by a belief in the importance of nurturing talent, building character, and preparing young people for a brighter future.

As the founder of Mary Gold, Ms. Igwe Mary seeks to support meaningful youth development initiatives that inspire growth, strengthen confidence, and encourage responsible leadership. Her vision is to see young people equipped with the values, knowledge, and opportunities they need to make a positive difference in society.

Ms. Igwe Mary's work through Mary Gold reflects her commitment to empowering the next generation and contributing to a society where young people can thrive and fulfil their potential.
